newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Orbital says signs Asian motorcyle deal.
newsitem.headline: Orbital says signs Asian motorcyle deal.

text.p: Engine designer Orbital Engine Corp Ltd said on Friday it has signed a technical co-operation agreement with one of Asia's largest motorcycle manufacturers.
Orbital said the agreement covered engineering programmes and granted licence rights for high volume production of motorcycles and scooters using Orbital engine technology.
Orbital said it was unable to name the licensee for commercial reasons.
However, it described the company as a rapidly growing manufacturer pursuing a dominant position in Chinese and South East Asian markets.
Orbital is headquartered in Australia with operations in the U.S., Europe and Asia.
